title: Colts free agent Alec Pierce’s market ‘expected to be robust’ during upcoming legal tampering period

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts free agent Alec Pierce’s market ‘expected to be robust’ during upcoming legal tampering period
sources.description: The Colts’ odds of retaining lead wideout Alec Pierce appear to be getting increasingly less likely by the day as his free agency rapidly approaches.
